newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner denies interest in Postbank.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner denies interest in Postbank.

text.p: Germany's Dresdner Bank AG on Thursday denied a pair of media reports saying the Frankfurt bank was interested in buying a majority stake in state-owned Deutsche Postbank AG.

The Sueddeutschen Zeitung and the Platow Brief newsletter both said on Thursday working papers from the London investment bank Schroders expressed Dresdner's interest in taking the stake in the bank, which is tied to the German postal system.

The information from Schroder laid out possibilities for the privatisation of Postbank by the federal government, with Bonn favouring Dresdner's recommendation due to its profit potential, the media organisations said in separate statements.
Both news organisations issued the statements ahead of publication on Friday of articles about Postbank.
But a Dresdner spokesman said: "We do not want to buy either a majority stake or a minority stake in Postbank."
A Finance Ministry spokesman in Bonn declined to confirm the reports.

German banking industry sources said the reports may have been based on outdated information since Dresdner at one time may have been interested in taking a stake in Postbank but that was no longer the case.
